biggest_catch: County says 'up to $195' without publishing a per-position or per-shift breakdown; half-day rate not stated.
catches: Pay framed as 'up to $195' — per-position breakdown not published in the county's current release.
Half-day shifts are offered but the half-day rate is not stated.
Training is compensated but the training amount is not stated.
Must be a registered voter in Bucks County (or a 17-year-old student via Youth at the Booth).

c2.evidence: 'Poll workers in Bucks County can earn up to $195 for a full day's work on Election Day, and are also compensated for attending training. Half-day shifts are also available.'

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

c4.evidence: No risk capital; county stipend for election work.

eligibility: Registered voter in Bucks County PA; students 17+ via Youth at the Booth; training required.

steps: Be a registered voter in Bucks County (or 17+ student via Youth at the Booth).
Submit the Pennsylvania Poll Worker Interest Form via BucksCounty.gov/Elections.
Attend the county's poll worker training (compensated).
Work Election Day — full-day (up to $195) or half-day shift.
timing: Election-day only (full or half-day) plus paid training beforehand.
